concept: Review and integration: what caring about others feels like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of noticing feelings, helping without expecting anything back, and being kind to someone different — which feels most natural to you?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'compassion' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
